title: A Phase Transition for Small Dense Subhypergraphs
summary: The local--global principle, which concerns the relationship between local structure and global parameters, has attracted considerable attention in extremal combinatorics over the past few decades. In this paper, we study how global density forces small dense subhypergraphs in uniform hypergraphs. For fixed $r\ge3$ and $s>1$, let $t_r(n,d,s)$ be the smallest integer $t$ such that every $n$-vertex $r$-graph of average degree at least $d$ contains a nonempty subhypergraph on at most $t$ vertices with average degree at least $s$.
